sql: SELECT "city"."County_ID" AS k, (CAST("city"."Multiracial" AS REAL) / "city"."Hispanic") AS m1 FROM "city" WHERE (CAST("city"."Multiracial" AS REAL) / "city"."Hispanic") IS NOT NULL ORDER BY m1 DESC LIMIT 10
quantities: city.share of population identifying as Multiracial relative to share of population identifying as Hispanic
why: share of population identifying as Multiracial / share of population identifying as Hispanic: a ratio of two quantities in percent
rank city rows by share of population identifying as Multiracial relative to share of population identifying as Hispanic

sql: SELECT "city"."County_ID" AS k, ("city"."Black" - "city"."Hispanic") AS m1 FROM "city" WHERE ("city"."Black" - "city"."Hispanic") IS NOT NULL ORDER BY m1 DESC LIMIT 10

why: share of population identifying as Black - share of population identifying as Hispanic: both in percent and of the same kind (stocks) on the same one city
